items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Suger Lou and Eddie? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Sugar Lou and Eddie. Both of them sang and they had a five or six piece band...

ctx.x: that's a rock band, at that time, something like Georgia Lee in East Texas, they were very popular.

Yes. Sugar Lou and Eddie. Both of them sang and they had a five or six piece band and so this guy said, ask him, I don't work no bands and don't pay them, and he did. He somehow got money. He said I can kind of see how you all feel and I said, goodness, we don't have to go through that, and so we came back home to Tulsa and were playing around there.
